Fendi Bag Sparks Debate Over Cultural Appropriation and Indian Craftsmanship

Fendi's latest Baguette bag, priced at approximately ₹8.3 lakh ($10,000), has ignited a debate on social media regarding cultural appropriation and recognition of Indian craftsmanship. Critics argue the bag's design closely resembles intricate Gujarati craftsmanship without acknowledging its origin. Fendi has defended the bag, stating it was meticulously crafted in Italy. Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, a prominent figure, publicly criticized the bag, asserting it undermines authentic Indian talent.
